title: Rabbi Yannai the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Megillah 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.32a.16), Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder spoke in the name of Rabbi Yannai the Great. In [Nedarim 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.22a.2), a son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder’s daughter came before Rabbi Yannai the Elder, who released him from his vow.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Nedarim names the Elder as the sage who released the vow. [Heilprin’s Yannai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2064&lang=en) gives Yannai the Great in that role and distinguishes the Megillah transmission.
